def lookup(entries, key, logger)
  record = entries[key]
  unless record
    return nil
  end
  message = "Found #{key}"
  logger.write(message)
  return record
end

cases.source:
def tally(words)
  counts = Hash.new(0)
  words.each do |word|
    key = word.downcase
    if key.empty?
      next
    end
    counts[key] += 1
  end
  return counts
end
